turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.

Before you came in, so after the zero was already in. Under your own procedure 4.2, I was supposed to be contacted before any mark went in, and what exactly did you tell the vice principal about my son? If anything has gone on Owen's file, it comes off today, or I'm in the principal's office tonight and at the board after that.
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.

Then you'll have it in writing from her. And if policy is policy, Hale, your own policy says I get a call before any mark goes in, and Owen gets heard first.

Was he?
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
A courtesy. Your procedure calls it a requirement, and you skipped it. Now show me something other than a machine's opinion, or I'm walking upstairs.
